content: As listed by Melvin-Koushki, levels four to seven are: (4) the illuminationist philosophers, previously called the ancient school of philosophy; (5) the 'verifying' or theoretically penetrating mystics, especially of Ibn ʿArabī's school, advocates of direct intuitive experience (ahl-i shuhūd); (6) the lettrists (ramz-khwānān-i ḥurūf-i qurʾānī, arbāb-i ʿilm-i ḥurūf); (7) ʿAlī and the line of the Imams after him, the sole mediators of the Prophetic legacy.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
